answer: Stake-weighted jury duty with slashing: each identity must lock a bond earned only through prior graded work, and random juries re-grade a sample of every answer. Forging ten thousand sparrow accounts gains nothing, because new identities start with zero bond and cannot judge or earn until real work accumulates; getting caught copying pigment from old answers or scraping shale-grade filler slashes the bond, so each fake identity costs more time and stake than honest work pays.
